Proposition
[compact steady and expanding gradient solitons are Einstein] Source: cao-zhu 1. Proposition 1.1.1\group Cao–Zhu The Ricci Flow On a compact $n$-manifold, every gradient steady or expanding Ricci soliton is Einstein.
Proof

\sketch For a steady soliton \cite{Ha95F, CK04}, tracing and differentiating the soliton equation give $R+\Delta f=0$ and $R+| abla f|^2=C$. Compactness gives $C=0$, hence $\int _M| abla f|^2\dd V=0$. For an expanding soliton, the corresponding identities are $R+\Delta f=n\lambda $ and $R+| abla f|^2-2\lambda f=C$ with $\lambda <0$; evaluating their difference at the extrema of $f$ forces $f$ to be constant.

□
